title: RIPR Cache Status
description: The document `ripr cache status --json` writes to stdout: where the ripr cache is, whether it could be read, and how much of it ripr owns. `schema_version` versions this report, not the on-disk cache layers. The counts describe files on disk at the time of the run; they say nothing about whether a later `ripr check` will hit the cache.

cache_dir.description: The cache directory as resolved from `RIPR_CACHE_DIR` or the workspace default, in the host's own path spelling.

real_cache_dir.description: The real directory that was inspected when the configured cache path traverses a symlink or junction, as its leaf or through an ancestor; otherwise `null`.

status.description: `ok`; `not_found` (no cache directory yet); `partial` (something under the cache directory could not be read, so the counts are lower bounds); `unavailable` (the inspected path is not a directory, is a broken symlink, or its metadata could not be read).

total_size_bytes.description: Bytes in the recognized ripr cache layers, the set `ripr cache clear` removes.

entry_count.description: Regular files in the recognized ripr cache layers.

foreign_entry_count.description: Regular files under the cache directory outside the recognized layers. `ripr cache clear` preserves them.
